contract: No guest register updates or operand/device transfers during planning
Full-format pointer indirection may peek only independently permitted ordinary RAM
Both final operands must be permitted before native execution
Code and extension permissions are checked; reserved forms deopt
PC-relative base is the extension-word address
Immutable compiled words are embedded in the owning JIT block
LEA does not require its computed final address to be mapped
scope: MOVE/MOVEA and LEA development gate; physical bus only; other memory/control, MMU/FPU and partial-device continuation remain separate gates

single_operand_policy.contract: Check read and write permission before any operand transfer; CLR write-only, TST/CMPI read-only; immediate words precede EA extensions; no locked/MOVEM/control admission
manual_text_references: M68000PRM PDF178: CLR memory read-before-clear note applies to MC68000/MC68008

single_operand_policy.evidence_scope: Independent planner unit tests plus separate immutable host-ALU/GPR/CCR/RAM/device-once and actual guest format7/RTE qualification cohorts; see manifests

preparatory_movem_policy.permissions: Complete popcount(mask)*size span, predecrement lower bound, actual transfer direction, mask before EA extensions
